name: Wounds
overview: Scripture reveals that wounds, both physical and spiritual, require careful treatment and divine healing. The Lord promises health and healing to those who obey His commandments, as seen in Exodus 15:26, and He strengthens and cares for the afflicted during times of sickness (Psalms 41:3). God not only heals physical wounds but also binds the brokenhearted, demonstrating His tender care for our deepest griefs (Psalms 147:3). Practical wisdom is also given, such as the cleansing effect of wounds to purge evil (Proverbs 20:30), while Isaiah 1:6 warns of the consequences when wounds are neglected and left unbound, emphasizing the importance of proper treatment.
